name: Open Station
description: Brand tokens for Open Station, the open-source WordPress plugin that turns wp-admin into a desktop OS.

pulsar.$description: Pulsar. Neon identity accent. RGB 242, 82, 252. HSL 296, 97, 65.

nebula.$description: Nebula. Soft identity accent. RGB 236, 155, 255. HSL 289, 100, 80.

starlight.$description: Starlight. Light contrast color. RGB 255, 251, 255. HSL 300, 100, 99.

void.$description: Void. Darkest brand color, base background. RGB 12, 11, 15. HSL 255, 15, 5.

holomesh.$description: Holomesh. Soft holographic gradient mesh for hero surfaces.

pulsarmesh.$description: Pulsarmesh. Neon magenta gradient mesh for hero surfaces.

sans.$description: Everything human: headlines, UI copy, body text.

mono.$description: The instrument voice: labels, metadata, statuses, coordinates. Small, uppercase, letterspaced.

rules: The logomark and the wordmark always travel together.
Wordmark is set in Geist at weight 520 with tracking -0.03em.
App icon: dark rounded square (radius 113/512) with inner shadow 3px 3px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.25); the mark sits inside an 18% margin and may be filled with a mesh.
Construction and clear-space ratios are provisional.

mascot.name: Mio
mascot.description: A small ghost blob that lives aboard the station: it glows in Pulsar, drifts between windows, and shows up where the interface has something to say.
mascot.status: Final form, expressions, poses and usage rules to be defined.

license.summary: Open Station is an open-source WordPress plugin (GPL). Brand assets are meant to be reused; fonts are SIL OFL 1.1.
